learning_objective: 🎯 Let us travel through time using Simple and Continuous Tenses for the Past, Present, and Future!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Simple Present tells about our daily habits. Simple Past tells us about what is already finished. Simple Future tells us what will happen later!
We add 'is/am/are + ing' to the verb for things happening exactly at this moment. Example: I am eating a tasty apple right now.
We add 'was/were + ing' for an action that was going on at a specific time in the past. Example: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

fun_activity.title: ⏳ Time Travel Sentences
fun_activity.instructions: Write down 'I jump.' Now change it into the future 'I will jump' and then into present continuous 'I am jumping'!

quick_recap: ⭐ Simple Tenses show basic facts, daily habits, or finished actions.
⭐ Continuous Tenses show action in progress and always use a verb with '-ing' at the end!
⭐ We use 'is/am/are' for present continuous and 'was/were' for past continuous.
